mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.9% over the past year.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in UNRATE above 4.0% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, reflecting concerns about labor market tightness and reduced growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns remain positive when UNRATE crosses above 4.0% in the last 6 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in quarterly demand (GDPC1) and monthly supply (INDPRO) above their respective 90th percentile levels signal robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are above their 12-month rolling averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 1.95% during a tightening cycle compresses discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is in a tightening phase (3 consecutive months above previous month).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly labor demand (PAYEMS) above its 90th percentile level signals a strong job market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns negative when PAYEMS is in the top 10% of its 12-month rolling values.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in monthly supply (INDPRO) below 100.0 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, reflecting reduced production capacity and potential supply bottlenecks.
failure_condition: 60d returns positive when INDPRO remains below 100.0 for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high labor demand (PAYEMS) and rising overall demand (GDPC1) above their respective 90th percentile levels signal robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not positive when both PAYEMS and GDPC1 are in the top quartile of their 6-month rolling averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained UNRATE below 3.5% in a low unemployment regime signals strong labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns negative when UNRATE is in the bottom 5% of its 12-month rolling values.
